steps.undone: The woodbox is empty and the stove is cold.
Wood from under the eaves, an armful at a time.
The box is full. Now the stove.

errands.done: The stove is lit. The house holds its warmth.
errands.let_go: The stove can stay cold. Nobody is coming back to it.

steps.undone: One cup in the cupboard. There were always two.
Her cup was out on the porch rail, under the snow.
Both cups on the table. The kettle wants the stove.

errands.done: Two cups and the kettle warm, as if she were only late.
errands.let_go: One cup on the table. It will have to do.

steps.undone: Red wool on the window frame.
Red wool, the birches, the stump. It goes on.
The thread ends at a birch. Something lies in the snow there.

errands.done: Her glove at the end of it, and our letters in the bark.
errands.let_go: I stopped following the thread. Let it lead someone else.

steps.undone: It will be dark soon, and the storm lamp is empty.
Oil from the janitor's room. The lamp hangs on the porch.
The lamp is lit. Take it with me.

errands.done: A light in my hand for the dark.
errands.let_go: No lamp. I will walk in the dark.
